root_cause.summary: Failed R1 blind boxes were emitted as source-space xyxy on the correct 1336×744 frames, but were not pixel-verified against the raw image. Grid-cell narrative labeling produced plausible-looking numbers that mostly landed on empty turf. This is not a canvas/letterbox/xywh storage transform bug.
